task.title: L12.26 second independent read-only QC of L12.25 and the two original P1 repros
task.objective: Owner request of 2026-10-06: run awkit-djnl.21.26, a read-only, independent QC of L12.25 (dfb9a036). An independent reviewer (awkit-qc-reviewer subagent, read-only tools) judged the code and evidence; the orchestrator re-ran the two original QC repros unmodified and the reviewer's probes from gitignored scratch files. Findings are filed, not fixed. Phase L hardening is not declared closed.

acceptance.description: An independent read-only review reports whether both original repros now refuse or act only on the intended element, whether any new wrong-element path exists in the L12.25 changes, and whether the new verifiers can pass vacuously; each finding filed with severity.

evidence.command: awkit-qc-reviewer subagent (read-only), original repros tmp/qc-l12/twin-cap-repro.mts and similar-rows-state-repro.mts, probes tmp/qc-l12/l12-26-probes.mts
evidence.observed: The QC ran and reported (verdict on L12.25: FAIL). Original repros on 1b9ef4dd: twin-cap refuses at 0, 7, 8 and 12 (pre-existing-twin), similar-rows-state offers no loop. Findings filed as awkit-djnl.21.27. Reviewer NOT CHECKED: the twin-pool verifier, pinned counts, loopRowDepth plumbing and designer round trip, old-record handling, the agreement re-proof.
177/177 with 'Sources agree' on the first run after moving the pins (361 issues, 24 outstanding / 337 closed, 248 edges).
